basics.name: John Riley
basics.title: Principal Agile Coach & Professional Scrum Trainer (PST)
basics.summary: Passionate Agile Trainer, Part-time Technologist, and Professional Learner with 30+ years of software delivery, manufacturing operations, and organizational transformation experience.

bullets.text: Founded Ready Set Agile and secured official state accreditation with the Ohio State Board of Career Colleges and Schools.
Designed and delivered Scrum.org courseware (APS, PSPO AI Essentials) and custom Agile & Generative AI training for clients including MIT Lincoln Laboratory, Worthington Steel, and World Class Title.
Founded NextGenTalent Lab to deliver workforce readiness programs and grant-funded Applying Professional Scrum (APS) credentials to high school students.
Coached enterprise teams using Evidence-Based Management (EBM), DORA metrics, and Training From The Back of The Room (TFTBOTR) techniques.
Scrum Master for teams of ~40 members across contact center, claims, and supply products.
Delivered two-day Agile foundations courses across 16 sessions to ~200 members.
Coached PMO and portfolio management teams on scaled agile product development.
Served as Scrum Master for the company's largest Agile initiative ($500K+ projects).
Established working group for advanced technical practices including Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) and automated testing.
Architected real-time hardware simulator and automated shop floor inventory systems using Lean Six Sigma principles.
Introduced eCommerce department to Agile software development methodologies and Scrum framework.
